description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); T(n LONG, t TEXT(255)) with n = 1..60, t 250 characters, no index. No deletes (only the last page has room). Then a table-type AddNew of n = 1000. Then a table-type recordset over T walked from MoveFirst, reading each row's Bookmark and n. Asks which page with free space the new row lands on.
